name: globecraft
summary: Explore the Earth in a 3D globe
description: Satellite imagery, live layers, search, KML places and distance measurements.

globecraft.override-build:
craftctl default
install -Dm644 packaging/globecraft.desktop "$CRAFT_PART_INSTALL/usr/share/applications/globecraft.desktop"
install -Dm644 assets/packaging/icon_256.png "$CRAFT_PART_INSTALL/usr/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/globecraft.png"
install -Dm644 packaging/globecraft.metainfo.xml "$CRAFT_PART_INSTALL/usr/share/metainfo/io.github.fireflythereal.globecraft.metainfo.xml"
install -Dm644 LICENSE "$CRAFT_PART_INSTALL/usr/share/licenses/globecraft/LICENSE"
